subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, with a new authenticated browser microphone-audio RPC?
rationale: The implementation direction is plausible, but accepting this boundary is a product and security decision that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Continue after port, fixes, and proof
options.body: Require the branch or a replacement to port onto current main, fix the line-level blockers, and provide redacted successful microphone-to-Gateway-to-draft proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the feature issue
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open while maintainers decide the core dictation boundary and ownership.

options.title: Close or supersede this branch
options.body: If maintainers prefer a fresh implementation or do not want core dictation now, close this PR and route future work through the paired issue or a new narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Continue after port, fixes, and proof
